data.long_meaning: Eeshaani is a name of the Hindu goddess Lakshmi. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Eesha', which means 'rich' or 'prosperous'. Eeshaani is the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. She is often depicted as having four arms, holding a lotus flower, a gold coin, a bowl of rice, and a lotus bud in her hands. She is also known as the goddess of fertility and motherhood.
